title: sclarea × sylvestris
intro: Sclarea × sylvestris, commonly known as Sclarea, is a hybrid of the Sclarea leonorus and the Sclarea rosea plants. It is a flowering plant belonging to the mint family, known for its aromatic properties and potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sclarea include its use as a carminative, digestive aid, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it beneficial for treating digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sclarea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
